name: jp.ilib.uicontrol
description: Prefab-authored UI state animation and screen control. Optional integrations (Input System, LitMotion, GameStateStructure, UVMBinding) are enabled by Version Defines.

samples.description: Application-side FIFO display requests using PageHandle. No result protocol is required by UIStack.
IViewModel, queued results, nine reward rows and Prefab-authored animations. Requires the Queued Pages sample, UVMBinding, Input System and LitMotion 2.0.2 or later.
